name: AI Front Matter
description: Writes a title, a one-line description, tags and a URL slug into a note's front matter with your AI model, reusing the tags your other notes already use.
author: Typora Team

includeTitle.title: Title
includeTitle.description: Generate Front Matter suggests titles to pick from.

includeDescription.title: Description
includeDescription.description: One sentence for search results and post excerpts.

includeSlug.title: Slug
includeSlug.description: A URL slug, in English words for non-Latin titles.

overwrite.title: Replace existing values
overwrite.description: Off: keeps a title, description or slug the document already has, and adds new tags to its tags.

folderTags.title: Reuse tags from the open folder
folderTags.description: Reads the front matter of up to 300 notes in the folder and asks the model to prefer those tags.

listStyle.title: Write new lists as
listStyle.description: Lists already in the front matter keep their style.

language.title: Language
language.description: Write titles and descriptions in this language, e.g. English.

maxChars.title: Characters sent
maxChars.description: How much of the document, from the start, goes to the model.
